instruction: Can you enable full-screen mode in GIMP by modifying the appropriate setting?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling full-screen mode by setting fullscreen-on-startup to 'yes' in GIMP sessionrc config. Uses existing check_config_status metric to verify the configuration.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable full-screen mode in GIMP
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly extracts the sessionrc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses the config file and checks for 'fullscreen-on-startup yes'
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Data flow is correct: quit GIMP -> read config file -> parse and check key-value pair
Metric parameter handling is correct: receives rules dict directly as expected parameter (not wrapped)
Expected rules correctly specify key='fullscreen-on-startup' and value='yes'
Minor cosmetic issue: typo 'type:' instead of 'type' in rules (line 44), but doesn't affect functionality since metric doesn't use this field
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix typo in expected.rules: change 'type:' to 'type' (line 44) for consistency, though this is cosmetic only
